moduleTitle: The environment and where people live

note.title: The environment and where people live
note.specFocus: Home and town, urban and rural life, buildings and facilities, weather, pollution, climate change, recycling, transport, and individual and collective action.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
The environment and where people live

Key vocabulary
- el barrio; las afueras; la vivienda; el ayuntamiento; la contaminación; el calentamiento global; reciclar; ahorrar; el contenedor; tirar; el transporte público; la sequía; sostenible

Key grammar
- Use vivir in location, hay to say what exists, estar for location, and comparatives for towns. Use se puede/se debe for environmental advice and si clauses for possible solutions.

Exam tips
- Link each problem to a practical solution. Remember ser for climate descriptions and hacer weather expressions, and use más/menos before adjectives.

questions.examTip: Build a short description, an opinion with porque and a personal or hypothetical comment.
questions.modelAnswer:
En la foto se ven vecinos que limpian un parque con guantes y bolsas. Las personas parecen concentradas y de buen humor. A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre el medio ambiente y el lugar donde vives. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see neighbours cleaning a park with gloves and bags. The people seem focused and in good spirits. In my opinion, this situation is positive because it shows something important about the topic. I would also like to take part because it would be useful and memorable.)
questions.question: Describe this photo showing neighbours cleaning a park with gloves and bags. Explain what the people are doing, make two reasonable inferences and give your own justified opinion about the topic.

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Vivo en las afueras, cerca de un parque y de la estación. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) El ayuntamiento construirá carriles para bicicletas el próximo año.

(English: — I live on the outskirts, near a park and the station. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — The council will build cycle lanes next year.)
questions.question: Role-play: your teacher plays a Spanish friend. Talk about el medio ambiente y el lugar donde vives. You must: (1) say what you normally do or prefer, (2) explain your opinion and a reason, and (3) respond to the unexpected question: “What happened recently?”

(English: — My neighbourhood has a new sports centre, but there is no cinema. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — Last week my neighbours cleaned the river in the park.)
